about: The bow sounds: 48 kHz 16-bit mono WAVs, every file's peak at -1 dBFS. Play a sound at its "gain" (multiply) so the set is levelled against itself: swings under hits, hits under heavy hits, the finishing blow the loudest. Pick one of the files at random each time. loud_db: the loudest 50 ms of the file before the gain; target_db: where it should sit (the sword's hit = about 0).

shoot_a.use: the bow being shot: an English longbow's snap (raw); as loud as the game's current shoot at its gain
shoot_a.anchor: shoot_1.wav at gain 0.473; target 0 dB relative to it
